description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per endpoint - the payment buys one signed payability verdict for the one endpoint URL you name: this service fetches that endpoint's live 402 challenge exactly as an unauthenticated stranger would, decodes the challenge body and the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, and returns the verdict state (POPULATED, AMOUNTS-ONLY, UNCONFIGURED, HEADER-MISSING, RESOURCE-MISMATCH, or NOT-A-402) with every field-check factor and an as-of timestamp. No composite score is computed. The challenge is fetched once, at check time, and is never stored.

url.description: The one endpoint URL to grade. Fetched once at check time (twice, back to back, for the memo op) and never stored.

name: payability_check
